sections.description: Travel Agency WDA is a responsive, multifunctional, and modern WordPress theme designed specifically for travel websites and blogs. The theme comes with various features and functionality that make it easy to create a travel website from scratch. The WordPress Travel Agency theme comes with a ready-made and customizable homepage with different sections available. The following sections are available: Banner, Team Members, Advantages, Parallax Effect, Services, Testimonials, WooCommerce, Sales, Benefits of Ordering, Our Partners, Shop by Category, Call to Action, Achievements, and Latest Posts. Some of these sections are also available as patterns, so you can use them on other pages of your website as well. All of these sections are fully customizable, so you can change any element or the entire design of the sections. You can also change the order of sections or hide those you don't need. The WordPress Travel Agency theme gives you a powerful and modern homepage that will definitely make a great first impression on your site visitors. Apart from its powerful homepage, this theme is fully integrated with WooCommerce. This means you can use WooCommerce to sell services or trips online. We have added a custom search bar for WooCommerce to improve the navigation of your store pages for your site visitors. Plus, the design and layout of your store pages are customizable, so you have complete control over them. The WordPress Travel Agency theme also comes with a customizable blog page. You need to create a page with the slug/title "blog" and you will be able to manage the layout, design, and other settings of the blog page from the admin panel. Whether you are a large travel agency, a newbie in this field, or even a small business, this WordPress theme will be a great solution for you. You can check out our theme page to learn more, or you can check out the demo page of the Travel Agency WDA WordPress theme to see it in action.
